name: Privacy Map
description: An OpenStreetMap of your location that loads only after a visitor clicks Show map. Until then it is your address on a placeholder, and nothing is fetched from another site.

panels.title: Privacy map
panels.description: Type [map] on a page where the map should go, or pick a page below to add it at the end. The map comes from OpenStreetMap and loads only when a visitor clicks Show map. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show the map
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: name
fields.title: Place name
fields.description: The heading on the map, like your business name. Optional.

fields.name: address
fields.title: Address
fields.description: Shown on the placeholder, one line per line of the address.

fields.name: location
fields.title: Location on the map
fields.description: Paste a link from openstreetmap.org, or coordinates like 52.3731, 4.8922. On openstreetmap.org, right-click your place and choose Show address to find them.

fields.name: zoom
fields.title: Zoom
fields.description: From 3 (a country) to 19 (a single building). 16 shows the streets around you.

fields.name: page
fields.title: Also add it at the end of this page
fields.description: A page's slug, like contact. Leave it empty to show the map only where you type [map].

fields.name: remember
fields.title: Remember the visitor's choice
fields.description: After a visitor shows a map once, show maps straight away on their next visits. The choice is kept in their own browser only.
